description: Copilot token hit-rate and cost dashboard backed by a shared local Token Tracker server.
command.openDashboard: Token Tracker: Open dashboard in browser
command.importLocalTraces: Token Tracker: Import local Copilot OTel data
config.autoStart: Automatically start the bundled Token Tracker server when it is not running.
config.idleExitSeconds: Delay before the server exits after all clients (VS Code windows or browser dashboards) disconnect. 0 disables automatic exit.
config.serverDownloadBaseUrl: Server mirror URL prefix, e.g. https://mirror/tokentracker-server-1.0.0. Leave empty to use the latest GitHub server release.
config.statsRange: Time range used by the status bar and tooltip.
config.costUnit: Cost unit used by the status bar and tooltip.
config.usdRate: CNY value of one US dollar.
